statusVocabulary.started: a worker session was created for this unit and is running. Not a claim that the work is done.
statusVocabulary.returned_integrated: the worker pushed, the Captain reviewed the exact diff, and the commit is integrated on the Captain branch.
statusVocabulary.blocked_environment_source_corpus_not_mo: the worker stopped correctly at its source gate because the container carried no source bytes. Its branch is preserved and is resumed, not rebuilt. It completes no family, proves no artifact and opens no route.
statusVocabulary.returned_built_pending_captain_reproduct: the worker produced artifacts, but the Captain has not yet reproduced them independently. It counts as nothing until reproduced.
statusVocabulary.closed_invalid: not a Captain assignment. Nothing integrated.
statusVocabulary.reproduced_not_complete: the Captain re-ran the family generator and the artifacts regenerated byte-identical. The bytes are proven to be the generator output; the family is still not complete and opens no route.

packetWorkersMayLaunchBecause: No official-form packet worker launches until scripts/verify-packet-build-environment.mjs passes in the target container. The first wave failed on exactly this precondition.
